comment:
* OkHttp's internal cache interface. Applications shouldn't implement this:
 * instead use {@link com.android.okhttp.Cache}.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: void remove(Request request) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Remove any cache entries for the supplied {@code request}. This is invoked
   * when the client invalidates the cache, such as when making POST requests.

methods.name: void update(Response cached, Response network) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Handles a conditional request hit by updating the stored cache response
   * with the headers from {@code network}. The cached response body is not
   * updated. If the stored response has changed since {@code cached} was
   * returned, this does nothing.

methods.name: void trackConditionalCacheHit()
methods.comment: Track an conditional GET that was satisfied by this cache.

methods.name: void trackResponse(CacheStrategy cacheStrategy)
methods.comment: Track an HTTP response being satisfied with {@code cacheStrategy}.

methodNames: void update(Response cached, Response network) throws IOException
